name: dsh-auto-fold
description: 官方回合折叠模式为 Compact 时，打开会话自动加载全部历史，让官方原生回合折叠立即生效：不新增折叠行、不接管官方设置、数据完整无偏差。When the official turn-folding mode is Compact, auto-loads the full conversation history on session open so the official native per-turn folding engages — no extra fold rows, no takeover, always data-complete.
